title: Microbiology, B.S. (Eberly College of Science)
notes: Transition-year curriculum, fetched directly from the archived 2024-25 bulletin. This is the FIRST catalog year with the current 'options' structure (General Microbiology / Medical Microbiology) and the generic MICRB Elective List A/B/C pools that MICRB-2026.json also uses -- a real overhaul from the named-elective structure of MICRB-2022/2023.json. Degree minimum: 121 credits (bulletin's own stated total; down from 125 in 2022/2023). Common-requirement elective math already matches 2026 exactly, confirmed against this year's own bulletin text: 'MICRB Elective List A (Applied): 3cr' + 'MICRB Elective List B: 3cr' + 'MICRB Elective List C (free): 11cr' (common, all options) plus the General Microbiology option's own 'Select 6 credits from MICRB Elective List B' -- List A 3cr / List B 9cr / List C 11cr total, same as 2026, modeled here with the same slot-credit distribution (List A: 1x3cr; List B: 3x3cr; List C: 3+3+2+3=11cr matching this year's own 'Department List C' footnote label -- this year's bulletin still uses 'Department List C', not yet 'MICRB Elective List C', in its printed Suggested Academic Plan; the List-C rename happened by 2025-26, see MICRB-2025.json). Two confirmed real sequencing differences from 2025/2026 found in this year's own Suggested Academic Plan (General Microbiology, Cell Biology & Genetics Emphasis) that are NOT present in 2025 (independently fetched and checked side by side): (1) MICRB 401 and MICRB 450 are swapped -- this year places MICRB 401 in Year 3 Fall (alongside BMB 400/401 and MICRB 421W) and MICRB 450 in Year 4 Fall (alongside PPEM 456), the exact reverse of 2025/2026's placement; (2) the elective slot paired with MICRB 415 in Year 3 Spring is drawn from List A this year, versus List B in 2025/2026. Both are genuine one-year transitional quirks, not modeling errors -- verified by an independent fetch of the 2025-26 archive page, which already matches 2026's placement exactly for both. Retains 2022/2023's separate ENGL 15 (Semester 1) / CAS 100A/B/C (Semester 2) Gen Ed Foundations items rather than 2026's single merged item (this year's own bulletin text lists them as two distinct GWS-tagged foundation requirements); the GWS tag is preserved on the Semester 7 Gen Ed item per this year's own bulletin ('General Education Course (GWS)'). Already has the PHYS 211-or-250 / PHYS 212-or-251 and MATH 141/STAT 200/240/250 alternates that 2022/2023 lacked, and the BMB-or-MICRB 251/252 cross-listed alternate. Same MATH 3->4->21->22 real-prereq-chain scaffold as every other catalog year (Backend/catalogs/*.json prereq data isn't versioned per catalog year). 'etm' marks the same Entrance-to-Major gateway courses as every other year (CHEM 110, MATH 140, MICRB 201).
